label: corpus:fixture first
tree: #text "First post!"

label: corpus:fixture third
tree: #text "Third time\u0027s a charm."

label: corpus:fixture fourth
tree: #text "You know what the fellow said \u2013 in Italy, for thirty years under the Borgias, they had warfare, terror, murder and bloodshed, but they produced Michelangelo, Leonardo da Vinci and the Renaissance. In Switzerland, they had brotherly love, they had five hundred years of democracy and peace \u2013 and what did that produce? The cuckoo clock."

label: corpus:fixture sixth
tree: #text "The sense of unhappiness is so much easier to convey than that of happiness. In misery we seem aware of our own existence, even though it may be in the form of a monstrous egotism\u2014this pain of mine is individual, this nerve that winces belongs to me and to no other. But happiness annihilates us\u2014we lose our identity."

label: corpus:fixture tenth
tree: #text "I don\u0027t care a damn about men who are loyal to the people who pay them, to organizations...I don\u0027t think even my country means all that much. There are many countries in our blood, aren\u0027t there, but only one person. Would the world be in the mess it is if we were loyal to love and not to countries?"

tree:
<http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml div class="lexxy-content">
 #text "\n  First post!\n"
#text "\n"

label: rails:fixture third
tree:
<http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml div class="lexxy-content">
 #text "\n  Third time\u0027s a charm.\n"
#text "\n"

label: rails:fixture fourth
tree:
<http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml div class="lexxy-content">
 #text "\n  You know what the fellow said \u2013 in Italy, for thirty years under the Borgias, they had warfare, terror, murder and bloodshed, but they produced Michelangelo, Leonardo da Vinci and the Renaissance. In Switzerland, they had brotherly love, they had five hundred years of democracy and peace \u2013 and what did that produce? The cuckoo clock.\n"
#text "\n"

label: rails:fixture sixth
tree:
<http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml div class="lexxy-content">
 #text "\n  The sense of unhappiness is so much easier to convey than that of happiness. In misery we seem aware of our own existence, even though it may be in the form of a monstrous egotism\u2014this pain of mine is individual, this nerve that winces belongs to me and to no other. But happiness annihilates us\u2014we lose our identity.\n"
#text "\n"

label: rails:fixture tenth
tree:
<http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml div class="lexxy-content">
 #text "\n  I don\u0027t care a damn about men who are loyal to the people who pay them, to organizations...I don\u0027t think even my country means all that much. There are many countries in our blood, aren\u0027t there, but only one person. Would the world be in the mess it is if we were loyal to love and not to countries?\n"
#text "\n"

tree: #text "The sense of unhappiness is so much easier to convey than that of happiness. But happiness annihilates us\u2014we lose our identity."
